title: IIER Editorial 36(2): (i) SDGs for IIER in 2027; (ii) Miscellanea
text_snippet: IIER 36(3): Atkinson and McBeath (2026) - IIER Editorial 36(3): (i) SDGs for IIER in 2027; (ii) Miscellanea Issues in Educational Research, 2026, Vol 36(3), ii-vi. [ Contents Vol 36 ] [ IIER Home ] IIER Editorial 36(3): (i) SDGs for IIER in 2027; (ii) Miscellanea Roger Atkinson and Clare McBeath IIER Co-Editors , Australia (i) SDGs for IIER in 2027 The acronym SDG is well known to many from the work of the United Nations in promoting Sustainable Development Goals [1., 2.]. For this editorial, we invoke SDGs to signal a pressing need to develop a sustainable approach to the growing problems for IIER that were outlined in Editorial 36(2) [3.], especially the problem of Numbers received increasing . Our current template for advice to authors of articles 'rejected editorially' [defined in [3.], Table 1) includes the new and revised sentences: Thank you for the interest in IIER, logged as submission #xxx, but we regret to inform you that during August-September 2026 we have to impose an unusually high rejection rate and a severely constrained level of feedback. ... Please send your article to another journal. ... During 2025 IIER averaged 76.6 submissions per month, with an increase to 106.1 submissions per month average encountered for January-September 2026.
